description: Render a 3D model as 2D game sprites: one of its moves (from animate_3d_model) or the model standing, seen from 8 directions, 4, the two sides of a platformer, 4 isometric diagonals, or the front. 16 frames by default, at 32-512 px (pixel art up to 128, from the same pass as generated sprites; smooth above). Saved as an animated sprite asset linked to the model, one animation per direction, ready to export as a sheet or edit. Every render of the same model goes onto that one asset. Free.

animation.description: The move to render: its name ('walk'), preset or animation id. Empty = the model standing

directions.description: Which views: 8 around, 4 (down/right/up/left), platformer (right, left, side-on), isometric diagonals, or the front

size.description: Sprite size in pixels: 32-128 come out as pixel art, 256 and 512 as smooth renders

name: render_3d_sprites
